top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a change in director.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers have not been inspected monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have not been inspected monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Electric or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detectors-Inspection of CO System (26 TAC §746.5537(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The carbon monoxide detector had not been inspected and tested. The detector was tested during the inspection and was in working order.
